decision_rule: Only consider adding a new deployable sensor or active-probing objective if it resolves P0-close pairs with target-aligned evidence across multiple seeds.
failure_criteria: audit reuses H1-close pairs instead of M148 P0-close pairs
resolution is judged by feature distance alone without target alignment
results come from one seed only
vparallel or other diagnostic-only fields are promoted as actor inputs
hypothesis: M148 P0-close target-divergent pairs may require extra deployable signals, longer history, or active probing; if existing raw proxies do not resolve them target-aligned, the next direction should be belief/active-identification rather than input expansion.
success_criteria: consume M148 P0-close exported pairs across at least three seeds
report raw wheel, vparallel diagnostic, P0 longer-history, and extra-channel resolution separately
distinguish feature separation from target-aligned resolution
record whether to pursue input expansion, longer history, or active probing next
